content.user_title: Convert Markdown to WeChat Article HTML
content.value_statement: Markdown articles can lose formatting when pasted into the WeChat editor. This skill guides HTML generation with inline styles and local previews for manual publishing.
actual_capabilities: Convert a Markdown file or pasted Markdown into locally saved HTML with element-level inline CSS.
Select from 15 bundled styles using explicit identifiers or natural-language descriptions.
Generate one recommended style, six preview styles, or all 15 styles.
Create a linked local overview and a Markdown style index for multi-style comparisons.
Use the first main heading as title metadata and omit its duplicate from the article body by default.
Guide local HTML validation and checks for prohibited scripts, external resources, and unsupported styling.
limitations: The package provides agent instructions and CSS templates, not a standalone converter or automated test suite.
Publishing requires manual copying and pasting into WeChat; formatting still needs verification in the WeChat mobile preview.
Images become placeholders, tables become lists, and links remain plain text rather than interactive links.
Conversion normalizes line breaks and removes paragraph-ending Chinese full stops; it is not a lossless Markdown transformation.

use_cases.title: Format a Personal Essay
use_cases.description: Turn a Markdown essay into a Medium-inspired WeChat article with readable typography and no duplicate body title.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Updates
use_cases.description: Generate several layouts for product announcements and compare them in a linked local overview before selecting one.

use_cases.title: Publish Course Notes
use_cases.description: Apply the course style to lesson notes while preserving headings, lists, quotations, and code examples.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use dbs-wechat-html to convert [article.md] into WeChat HTML. Recommend one suitable style and generate it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first article without selecting a style identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Choose a Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use dbs-wechat-html with --style course for [lesson.md]. Keep the first heading as title metadata, not a duplicate body heading.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare teaching material with an explicit style and default title handling.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Compare Recommended Styles
prompt_templates.prompt: Use dbs-wechat-html with --preview for [announcement.md]. Generate six recommended styles, the linked overview, and the style index.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare alternative layouts before choosing a publication version.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Generate and Check Every Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Use dbs-wechat-html with --all for [report.md]. Validate each deliverable for inline styles, escaped text, and absent scripts or external resources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review all 15 layouts and verify the documented delivery constraints.

output_examples.input: Convert a Markdown personal essay using the medium style.
output: One local HTML article using serif typography and inline paragraph styling.
The opening heading becomes the browser-tab title and is omitted from the article body.
The completion message describes copying the article into WeChat and checking its mobile preview.

output_examples.input: Generate preview options for a Markdown product announcement.
output: Six HTML articles using minimal, medium, stripe, wired, ft, and course styles.
A local overview links to each article and labels its style and intended use.
A Markdown style index accompanies the comparison files.

output_examples.input: Convert course notes containing a table, an image reference, and a code block.
output: The table content becomes a list suitable for the WeChat editor.
The image reference becomes a descriptive placeholder rather than an embedded image.
The code block is displayed as escaped, styled text rather than executed.

best_practices: Specify a style or generation mode to avoid an additional selection question.
Compare layouts locally, then verify the chosen article in the WeChat mobile preview.
Check normalized punctuation, image placeholders, and converted tables against the source before publishing.
anti_patterns: Assuming a correct browser preview guarantees identical formatting after pasting into WeChat.
Requesting external fonts, scripts, embedded images, or complex interactive layouts.
Using this formatting workflow for editorial rewriting, exact source preservation, or automatic account publishing.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. File generation requires an environment with local file access.

faq.question: How many styles can I generate?
faq.answer: Generate one selected or recommended style, six recommended preview styles, or all 15 built-in styles.

faq.question: Does it publish directly to my WeChat account?
faq.answer: No. It prepares local HTML for manual copying and pasting into the WeChat Official Account editor.

faq.question: Why is my opening title missing from the body?
faq.answer: The first main heading becomes title metadata to avoid duplication. Explicitly request a visible body title to retain it.

faq.question: What happens to images, links, and tables?
faq.answer: Images become descriptive placeholders, links remain text, and tables are converted into lists for compatibility.

faq.question: Does conversion rewrite my article?
faq.answer: It does not perform editorial rewriting. It changes heading handling, normalizes line breaks, and removes paragraph-ending Chinese full stops.
